name: Counter-Strike 2
shortDescription: For over two decades, Counter-Strike has offered an elite competitive experience, one shaped by millions of players from across the globe. And now the next chapter in the CS story is about to begin. This is Counter-Strike 2.

name: Terraria
shortDescription: Dig, fight, explore, build! Nothing is impossible in this action-packed adventure game. Four Pack also available!

name: Rust
shortDescription: The only aim in Rust is to survive. Everything wants you to die - the island’s wildlife, other inhabitants, the environment, and other survivors. Do whatever it takes to last another night.

name: Stardew Valley
shortDescription: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?

name: Cyberpunk 2077
shortDescription: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in the dark future of Night City — a dangerous megalopolis obsessed with power, glamor, and ceaseless body modification.

name: Red Dead Redemption 2
shortDescription: Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde Gang are outlaws on the run. With federal agents and bounty hunters massing on their heels, the gang must rob, steal, and fight their way across the rugged heartland in order to survive.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition
shortDescription: You are Geralt of Rivia, mercenary monster slayer. Before you stands a war-torn, monster-infested continent you can explore at will. Your current contract? Tracking down Ciri — the Child of Prophecy, a living weapon that can alter the shape of the world.

name: ELDEN RING
shortDescription: THE CRITICALLY ACCLAIMED FANTASY ACTION RPG. Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring and become an Elden Lord in the Lands Between.

name: Left 4 Dead 2
shortDescription: Set in the zombie apocalypse, Left 4 Dead 2 is a co-operative action horror FPS takes you and your friends through the cities, swamps and cemeteries of the Deep South, from Savannah to New Orleans across five expansive campaigns.

name: Euro Truck Simulator 2
shortDescription: Travel across Europe as king of the road, a trucker who delivers important cargo across impressive distances! With dozens of cities to explore, your endurance, skill and speed will all be pushed to their limits.

name: Baldur's Gate 3
shortDescription: Baldur’s Gate 3 is a story-rich, party-based RPG set in the universe of Dungeons & Dragons, where your choices shape a tale of fellowship and betrayal, survival and sacrifice, and the lure of absolute power.

name: Phasmophobia
shortDescription: Phasmophobia is a 4 player online co-op psychological horror. Paranormal activity is on the rise and it’s up to you and your team to use all the ghost-hunting equipment at your disposal in order to gather as much evidence as you can.

name: ARK: Survival Evolved
shortDescription: Stranded on the shores of a mysterious island, you must learn to survive. Use your cunning to kill or tame the primeval creatures roaming the land, and encounter other players to survive, dominate... and escape!

name: Hollow Knight
shortDescription: Forge your own path in Hollow Knight! An epic action adventure through a vast ruined kingdom of insects and heroes. Explore twisting caverns, battle tainted creatures and befriend bizarre bugs, all in a classic, hand-drawn 2D style.

name: Lethal Company
shortDescription: A co-op horror about scavenging at abandoned moons to sell scrap to the Company.

name: Portal 2
shortDescription: The "Perpetual Testing Initiative" has been expanded to allow you to design co-op puzzles for you and your friends!

name: Dying Light
shortDescription: First-person action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open world overrun by flesh-hungry zombies. Roam a city devastated by a mysterious virus epidemic. Scavenge for supplies, craft weapons, and face hordes of the infected.

name: Don't Starve Together
shortDescription: Fight, Farm, Build and Explore Together in the standalone multiplayer expansion to the uncompromising wilderness survival game, Don't Starve.

name: Project Zomboid
shortDescription: Project Zomboid is the ultimate in zombie survival. Alone or in MP: you loot, build, craft, fight, farm and fish in a struggle to survive. A hardcore RPG skillset, a vast map, massively customisable sandbox and a cute tutorial raccoon await the unwary. So how will you die? All it takes is a bite..

name: Raft
shortDescription: Raft™ throws you and your friends into an epic oceanic adventure! Alone or together, players battle to survive a perilous voyage across a vast sea! Gather debris, scavenge reefs and build your own floating home, but be wary of the man-eating sharks!

name: Monster Hunter: World
shortDescription: Welcome to a new world! In Monster Hunter: World, the latest installment in the series, you can enjoy the ultimate hunting experience, using everything at your disposal to hunt monsters in a new world teeming with surprises and excitement.

name: Hades
shortDescription: Defy the god of the dead as you hack and slash out of the Underworld in this rogue-like dungeon crawler from the creators of Bastion, Transistor, and Pyre.

name: Sid Meier’s Civilization® VI
shortDescription: Expand your empire, advance your culture and go head-to-head against history’s greatest leaders. Will your civilization stand the test of time?

name: Halo: The Master Chief Collection
shortDescription: The Master Chief’s iconic journey includes six games, built for PC and collected in a single integrated experience. Whether you’re a long-time fan or meeting Spartan 117 for the first time, The Master Chief Collection is the definitive Halo gaming experience.

name: Satisfactory
shortDescription: Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory building game with a dash of exploration and combat. Play alone or with friends, explore an alien planet, create multi-story factories, and enter conveyor belt heaven!

name: Cities: Skylines
shortDescription: Cities: Skylines is a modern take on the classic city simulation. The game introduces new game play elements to realize the thrill and hardships of creating and maintaining a real city whilst expanding on some well-established tropes of the city building experience.

name: RimWorld
shortDescription: A sci-fi colony sim driven by an intelligent AI storyteller. Generates stories by simulating psychology, ecology, gunplay, melee combat, climate, biomes, diplomacy, interpersonal relationships, art, medicine, trade, and more.

name: Portal
shortDescription: Portal™ is a new single player game from Valve. Set in the mysterious Aperture Science Laboratories, Portal has been called one of the most innovative new games on the horizon and will offer gamers hours of unique gameplay.

name: Assassin's Creed® Odyssey
shortDescription: In this action-adventure game, set sail for Ancient Greece to alter its fate. Fight in visceral battles on land and sea, shape your destiny from outcast to legend, and uncover secrets of your past.

name: Europa Universalis IV
shortDescription: Rule your land and dominate the world with unparalleled freedom, depth and historical accuracy. Write a new history of the world and build an empire for the ages.

name: Total War: WARHAMMER II
shortDescription: The forces of Lustria await your command. Choose your Legendary Lord, expand your armies, forge alliances in a strategic turn-based campaign, and unleash the might of your monstrous forces in fast-paced real-time battles.

name: Age of Empires II (Retired)
shortDescription: Age of Empires II has been re-imagined in high definition. With the release of Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition, this product will not be updated further.

name: The Sims™ 4
shortDescription: Play with life and discover the possibilities. Unleash your imagination and create a world of Sims that’s wholly unique. Explore and customize every detail from Sims to homes–and much more.

name: Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) 40th Anniversary Edition
shortDescription: From gliders and helicopters to wide-body jets, fly highly detailed and accurate aircraft in the Microsoft Flight Simulator 40th Anniversary Edition. The world is at your fingertips.

name: Team Fortress 2
shortDescription: Nine distinct classes provide a broad range of tactical abilities and personalities. Constantly updated with new game modes, maps, equipment and, most importantly, hats!

name: Dota 2
shortDescription: Every day, millions of players worldwide enter battle as one of over a hundred Dota heroes. And no matter if it's their 10th hour of play or 1,000th, there's always something new to discover. With regular updates that ensure a constant evolution of gameplay, features, and heroes, Dota 2 has taken on a life of its own.

name: Nine Parchments
shortDescription: Runaway wizard apprentices, stolen spells, and no supervision. Blast, freeze and electrocute your way through a fairytale world in 1–4 player co-op, online or on the couch. Level up, collect staves and hats, and gather the Nine Parchments you need to complete your spellbook.

name: SOS OPS!
shortDescription: SOS OPS! is more than a game. Your task is to save the city. You will find yourself in the epicenter of madness, where co-op missions with friends will raise the adrenaline to the limit!

name: Warframe
shortDescription: Awaken as an unstoppable warrior and battle alongside your friends in this story-driven free-to-play online action game

name: Sixtar Gate: STARTRAIL
shortDescription: Sixtar Gate: STARTRAIL is a rhythm game for keyboard set against a space exploration backdrop. Captain your science vessel alongside your navigator Shii as you explore the vast Sixtar system!

name: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
shortDescription: A drifting simulator featuring an authentic competition format and a judging system inspired by modern drift championships. Enhanced and updated physics, developed in collaboration with the CarX Motorsport team.

name: Wretch: Divine Ascent
shortDescription: A 1v1 tactical auto battler game with elements of roguelike mechanics and backpack management in a dark medieval art style. It was inspired by Backpack Battles and developed with Unreal Engine. Create your own unique attack combos by arranging items in your backpack to connect moves.

name: Loot Tycoon
shortDescription: You are not the Hero—you are the Merchant who bleeds them dry! Dive into a unique mix of Hack & Slash and Shop Simulation. Farm dungeons with fully automated combat, loot legendary artifacts, and crash the market. Build your shop from a dirty rug to a medieval monopoly.

name: Lunarium
shortDescription: Lunarium is an atmospheric fantasy A-RPG. Play as Ave, a light-armored knight, who teams up with Lune, a mysterious Starfarer. Together, they journey to save a dying world, engaging in challenging battles to retrieve the lost glow of the stars and forsaken memories, unveiling cosmic secrets.

name: The Greenening
shortDescription: A short and wholesome incremental journey about exploring and reawakening a forgotten world. Wash away the ashes to discover the secrets hidden beneath, upgrade your versatile watering abilities, and grow your own cozy space garden.

name: Dobbel Dungeon
shortDescription: Gather your party, roll your dice and battle across the islands to put an end to a powerful curse once and for all in this roguelike turn-based tactical RPG!

name: Torque Drift
shortDescription: Build your car, earn sponsors, and compete in online multiplayer drift battles!

name: Giana Sisters: Twisted Dreams - Rise of the Owlverlord
shortDescription: Giana Sisters: Twisted Dreams is a fast-paced platformer that will plunge you into the heart of two opposing worlds.

name: IGNOBLE
shortDescription: Destroy enemies and harvest blood, bones, and marrow to grow stronger, unlock forbidden skills, and wipe out the Ignoble tyrants who dare threaten your master.

name: Blood Flowers
shortDescription: A puzzle ＆ plot single-player game. It all starts with the falling star ...... Through the puzzle, find the childhood memories while gradually unraveling the truth of the "Blood Tree Plague" hundreds of years ago.

name: Supercat Survivors
shortDescription: Meow! This is a cat-themed Survivor-like game where you control an adorable Supercat! Battle monsters to level up, collect items, upgrade weapons, and experiment with strategic builds to fight off invading creatures threatening Meow Star.

name: Fatal Claw
shortDescription: Dive into Fatal Claw, a Metroidvania game in vibrant 2D artwork. Explore the arcane underworld your way with Kisha. Your ultimate goal is to find the key to the surface world alongside other survivors, while vanquishing infected enemies and absorbing their power. Start your clawsome adventure now!

name: Moot District
shortDescription: Build and defend! Make Moot District yours!

name: SUPERVERSE
shortDescription: SUPERVERSE is a fast-paced, action-packed space shooter that launches you into an ancient network of interconnected universes. Your mission: travel back through space-time and prevent the extinction of humanity.

name: b 2
shortDescription: b 2: online multiplayer an alien place you are the bee: fly where you like, play as you like

name: Angel Legion
shortDescription: Idle or play whenever and wherever you want. Customize the looking of your favorite Angels. Automatically accumulate resources all the time.

name: Jungle Town: Birthday quest
shortDescription: A colorful educational adventure for children ages 2–5. Join six friendly animals, solve simple puzzles, find hidden objects, and practice attention, fine motor skills, and everyday habits while preparing a birthday surprise for the baby elephant. Play offline, with no adult help required.

name: Ukrainian Soccer  ( any two points directed towards the net can score )
shortDescription: This game allows to create scoring opportunities from many angles simultaneously what makes for a dynamic and exciting play. Direct any two points from your team towards the opponent's net and score. First party to score wins. It also features three board designs with zoom.

name: Battle Teams 2
shortDescription: Battle Teams 2 is a fast-paced multiplayer tactical shooter with Asian aesthetics. PvP offers action-packed game modes set in a rigorously balanced competitive gameplay environment. Cooperative PvE gameplay throws you and your friends into wave after wave of merciless adversaries.

name: The Deadly Path
shortDescription: Aid the Deities of Dread in their quest for vengeance and pave the way for their ascension. Gather grim materials, construct defences and expand the underworld to appease the rage of the gods in The Deadly Path, a unique building management and roguelike strategy game.

name: Ominoflux
shortDescription: Ominoflux will test your brain in a most peculiar way.

name: Tempest Tower
shortDescription: Tempest Tower is an action packed tower defense platformer where you must brawl with incoming hordes of Creepers while herding the local critters to safety. Build, fight, upgrade, overcome.

name: Patchkins Party
shortDescription: Patchkins is a multiplayer racing game for 2 to 8 players where you build the course as you play. Each round, players draw and place objects like Platforms, Obstacles, and Specials, then race to the finish without dying.

name: Chronicle Archive - Japan
shortDescription: Explore history like never before in Chronicle Archive - Japan! Customize your avatar, solve puzzles, collect badges, and connect with players worldwide in this immersive multiplayer adventure.

name: AstroScaper
shortDescription: Colonize barren asteroids and transform them into thriving space colonies. Discover powerful building synergies, solve satisfying placement puzzles, and journey from one procedurally generated world to the next.

name: Frontier Force Vanguard
shortDescription: Frontier Force Vanguard is an open-world, turn-based RPG where you take on missions and build your reputation and supports the Empire expansion.

name: Sad Virus Foodland
shortDescription: Walking simulation and adventure game where player controls virus character in foodland. Mission to avoid obstacles and find beer bottle

name: Rat Run
shortDescription: Jump your way through endless obstacles and smash incoming enemies as a cheese-thirsty rat! Accelerate to the maximum speed and unlock all biomes and playable rodents!

name: Monkey Wave
shortDescription: Monkey Wave is a fast-paced action clicker where you defend your banana stash against waves of hostile apes. Click rapidly to defeat primates and epic bosses in solo, co-op, and PvP modes. Deploy strategic abilities and survive the chaos of the jungle.

name: Hello Anxiety
shortDescription: Hello Anxiety is a pixel art narrative puzzle RPG set in a surreal world shaped by mental health struggles. Navigate eerie bookstores, silent streets, and haunting memories as you explore the layers of anxiety and self-doubt in this emotional, story-driven experience.

name: Eyes Of The ElderWood
shortDescription: Eyes Of The ElderWood is a first-person adventure horror set in Kashubian folklore, emphasizing diverse locations, challenges, and enemies. Draw spells to solve puzzles and deal with foes, or fight using a revolver. Keep an eye on your sanity level to avoid descending into madness.

name: Dream about yoU
shortDescription: A dashing blond partner drops in from the sky, declaring they're taking responsibility for you—but they need a small favor.Find them in your dreams, wake them up, and crack the dream maze. Sci-fi comedy, adventure starts now!

name: One Tower Defense
shortDescription: One Tower Defense is a Roguelike Tower Defense game where you control a single tower. Gather resources, buy weapons and upgrades, and fight endless waves of enemies. Play in single-player mode or in multiplayer mode, where the last survivor wins.

name: Police Chief Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
shortDescription: Free introduction to the full Police Chief Simulator game takes you to Winston Springs Police Station! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

name: AxeSlinger
shortDescription: AxeSlinger is a fast, movement based roguelite FPS where you shred through enemy infested dimensions using guitar weapons. Fight hordes, rack up insane combos, unlock abilities, and battle colossal bosses as The AxeSlinger on your path to ultimate power!

name: Restitutor: Empire Restored
shortDescription: Restitutor is a historical incremental grand strategy game focused on statecraft, diplomacy, and calculated warfare. Strengthen your economy, research new technologies, form alliances, and outmaneuver rivals through high-level strategic decisions without micromanagement.

name: Arrow Flow
shortDescription: Welcome to Arrow Flow - a stylish, minimalist puzzle game where every decision requires care and thoughtful strategy. Use logic and spatial thinking to direct all the arrows to the exit and prevent them from crossing.

name: Martha's Dolls 2
shortDescription: The viral horror hit returns. Step into the haunting ruins of the Martha's House , where every shadow conceals a threat and the porcelain dolls aren't just watching , they're hunting you.

name: Novel Forger: Suicide Mr. Fury
shortDescription: Suicide Mr. Fury is a Meta-Otome adventure that deconstructs the absurdity of falling for someone who doesn’t exist. Navigate branching paths, meta-narratives, and a multiverse of madness with the overbearing CEO, Mr. Fury, between digital delusion and harsh reality.

name: Slot Theory
shortDescription: A roguelike tower defense where every draft permanently mutates your build. Stack modifiers, trigger massive Surge events, and watch your defenses evolve into unstable, compounding systems that fight in ways you didn’t design.

name: Clutch Legend: FPS Career Simulator
shortDescription: Build a Counter-Strike-inspired esports career from nobody to legend. Master weapons, develop your skills, negotiate contracts, hire staff, and play or simulate every match on your road to the Major.

name: Dawn of Horror
shortDescription: Dawn of Horror is a fast-paced, brutal cyberpunk Battle Royale set in the decaying urban sprawl of Cygnus City, 2221. Following the collapse of civilization into a digital Dark Age, scavengers fight over the remaining ruins. Drop in, gear up, hack the system, and be the last one breathing.

name: BUNKER: RED FLAG
shortDescription: A global catastrophe has struck the world. A small group of survivors is trapped in an isolated shelter with resources too scarce for everyone. Take your seat at the table, convince the others you deserve to stay. Lie, pressure, manipulate – and decide who gets thrown out!

name: KESU-JI
shortDescription: KESU-JI is a game featuring 6 modes centered around various "merge" mechanics. (Puzzle Mode、Action Mode 、Shooting Mode) You can aim for high scores on the online leaderboards in each mode and earn rewards. Enjoy a satisfying merging experience set in a chill, relaxing atmosphere!

name: Pocket Dinos
shortDescription: An incremental dino collection game where prehistoric stickers come to life. Hatch eggs, discover unique variants, build thriving habitats, and uncover powerful combinations to grow your fortune.

name: DEMON SIEGE
shortDescription: Stack ridiculous power-ups infinitely in this retro-inspired FPS Bullet Heaven. Build completely broken combinations as you go from a lowly demon hunter to an unstoppable demon-slaying GOD. Includes Story Mode with multiple endings and Endless Mode.

name: Castleborne Survivors
shortDescription: A survivors-like game with side-scrolling action combat. Slash, dodge, and mow down endless monsters in a gothic horror castle. Upgrade with every choice, snowball out of control, and survive until the very end.

name: Source aged like fine wine: ballad of jets
shortDescription: A short, visceral, and physics-heavy descent into a personal third place. Spawn objects, defy the mockery of the void, and reach the flag before the burnout wins. Spawn lightweight Jets entities who smell nice, even when the world feels like a burden for you. Just dunno, puzzle game.

name: Toll: The Ferryman's Ledger
shortDescription: You are Charon. You take the coins from the eyes of the dead — and one of them, someday, must be your own. A short incremental with a real ending: five rivers, a tribute owed to Hades, and a price on your own freedom. It ends. That is the whole point.

name: Token x Token x Clicker
shortDescription: Run a tiny 3D office of robot employees — the Grammis — and pick up the token embers they drop. Win contracts on the lottery reel, ride out overtime rushes, renovate your one-room startup into a corporate tower, and climb to #1 in the market cap rankings. 200+ collectibles. Fully local.

name: CapyCam
shortDescription: There's no fuss here. There's only golden light, rustling grass, and dozens of friendly faces. Look for capybaras in the thicket, but remember the most important rule of photography: to capture the perfect shot, sometimes you just need to lower the camera.

name: CrystalStack
shortDescription: Build the tallest crystal tower you can. CrystalStack is a 3D physics-based stacking game developed with Unreal Engine 5. Carefully place transparent crystal cubes, keep your balance, and beat your highest score before the tower collapses. Relaxing to play, challenging to master.
